funders.name: Amateur Radio Digital Communications
funders.note: ARDC's own application instructions state that it aims to fund approximately $3.8 million in 2026 and funds about 30% of submitted proposals. It also underwrites ARRL's club grants, scholarships and Teachers Institute ($2.1M over three years, announced December 2023, per the 2026-08-02 research pass) — one leg with a splint, not two legs.

funders.name: American Radio Relay League
funders.note: robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 5 and disallows /files/file/protected, /attachments/download, /admin, /results-database and /volunteer-monitor-resources. All grant and scholarship pages are allowed. No ETag, no Last-Modified, Cache-Control: nocache, and every sitemap lastmod frozen at 2010 — which is why change detection hashes parsed entries rather than trusting headers.

funders.name: ARRL Foundation
funders.note: Administers the scholarship catalogue (the descriptions page yields 111 entries; ARRL's own text says 'more than 170 scholarships'), the Amateur Radio Grants programme and the Club Grant programme.

funders.name: Quarter Century Wireless Association
funders.note: Memorial Scholarship Fund: 624+ students and $930,350+ since 1978, per QCWA's own page. Requests open from October 31 and must reach ARRL before the first week of January; intake is ARRL's portal, not QCWA's.

funders.name: Young Ladies' Radio League
funders.note: One of only two verified non-ARRL US ham scholarship application paths. The captured page publishes no month, day or window anywhere, so no deadline is asserted for it.

funders.name: Austin Amateur Radio Club
funders.note: Self-hosted portal at grants.austinhams.org. It legitimately shows 'No opportunities available' between August 1 and April 30; an empty scrape here is not a failure.

funders.name: The Yasme Foundation
funders.note: Site 301s /feed/ and /wp-json/ to a 403 page for non-browser clients. Tracked via ARRL news RSS instead. We do not spoof a browser user agent to defeat a deliberate access policy.

funders.name: Northern California DX Foundation
funders.note: robots.txt and sitemap.xml both return 403. Manual curation only.

funders.name: Radio Club of America
funders.note: ClubExpress site. Only content.aspx query-string URLs resolve and the sitemap 403s. Module ids change without notice.

funders.name: Amateur Radio on the International Space Station (ARISS-USA)
National Aeronautics and Space Administration
funders.note: NSPIRES exposes no API, RSS, XML, JSON or CSV. Grants.gov is the only machine-readable route to NASA opportunities.

funders.name: IEEE Microwave Theory and Technology Society
Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
funders.note: mga.ieee.org returns HTTP 418 to non-browser clients, so rebate amounts are recorded from search snippets and are marked partial.

funders.name: Yaesu USA
funders.note: Programme window dates exist only inside the title line of a dated fillable PDF under /wp-content/uploads/{YYYY}/{MM}/. Any on-air sustainment term lives only inside that PDF, which this crawler never downloads — so it is unknown, and no such obligation is asserted anywhere in this corpus.

funders.name: Dayton Amateur Radio Association (Hamvention)
funders.note: Grantmaker only through its ARRL catalogue entry. Zero hrefs containing 'scholar' or 'grant' on w8bi.org; daytonhamvention.org did not resolve.

funders.name: Six Meter Club of Chicago
funders.note: k9ona.com returns 403 to every non-browser client and we do not spoof user agents, so the ARRL catalogue entry is the citable source.

funders.name: Campus student government associations
funders.note: Roughly 4,000 independent campuses on Qualtrics, CampusGroups, Presence and Engage. Not aggregatable at any scale; shipped as a playbook. The linked FSU page is the representative example the research verified.

funders.name: Foundation for Amateur Radio (FAR)
funders.note: FAR's own domain is compromised and is deliberately NOT linked from this record — see the far-domain-compromised programme record, which is where the domain is named and explained. FAR's historical portfolio (10-10, QCWA, YASME, K3IVO, CARA) appears absorbed into the ARRL Foundation, which is what this record links to instead.
